newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steadies in quiet, pre-holiday trading.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steadies in quiet, pre-holiday trading.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady to slightly higher on the back of crude's sharp gains late Friday, traders said on Monday.
But activity was very quiet heading into the end-of-the-year holidays and as end-user demand appeared satiated.
"People have basically covered whatever they have to cover," one trader said. "Having cargoes for sale these days, unless there is a specific time and quantity, it is difficult to find homes."
Swaps for the rest of December were up $1 at $219/$220 and Jan traded at $213/$215.
Cargoes were notionally valued unchanged at $219/$223 cif.
It was unclear if several bids for pipeline spec material heard on Friday were still in the market or matched up with sellers, traders said.
